hero.title: Stop Drinking Water Waste & Track Repairs in Real Time
hero.description: TIZGIN connects citizens, water utility repair brigades, and municipal leadership in one transparent ecosystem. Report pipeline ruptures or leaks with photos and GPS coordinates — every incident is tracked from initial report to verified resolution!
hero.principleFlow: Citizen Report → Digital Verification → Responsible Team Assignment → Repair Deadline → Repair Confirmation → Public Transparency

stats.estimationDisclaimer: * Note: Water savings are presented as estimated hydraulic values based on pipe diameter, pressure category, and response duration.

howItWorks.title: How TIZGIN Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Protecting our municipal drinking water network together in four transparent steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Take a photo of a leaking pipe or damaged valve. TIZGIN automatically detects GPS coordinates and runs optional AI image classification.
howItWorks.step2Desc: A unique Incident ID is generated and immediately routed to the regional water supply department and brigade manager.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Engineers set an estimated completion deadline. If a repair exceeds its deadline, automatic alerts escalate to managers.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Before-and-after repair evidence is uploaded. Citizens rate the fix, earn points, and receive official SUV ASROVCHISI certificates.
